context.problem_statement: Evaluate a product recommendation system using NDCG@10 (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at rank 10). For each user, you have a ranked list of recommended items and their relevance scores (0=not relevant, 1=somewhat relevant, 2=highly relevant). Compute: (1) DCG@10 for each user = sum(rel_i / log2(i+1)) for i=1..10, (2) Ideal DCG (IDCG@10) using the best possible ranking, (3) NDCG@10 = DCG/IDCG, (4) mean NDCG@10 across all users. Also compute Precision@5 and Recall@10 for each user.
context.expert_knowledge: DCG = sum(rel_i / log2(rank+1)) where rank starts at 1. IDCG = DCG with items sorted by descending relevance. NDCG = DCG/IDCG (ranges 0-1, 1=perfect ranking). Precision@K = relevant items in top-K / K. Recall@K = relevant items in top-K / total relevant items. NDCG is graded relevance metric; better than Precision@K for multi-level relevance judgments.
